title: sutera procumbens
intro: Sutera procumbens, commonly known as Creeping Sutera or Creeping Zexmenia, is a flowering plant species in the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Sutera procumbens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sutera procumbens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedation, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects.
